A recreation of “Sunset Moment”, the first hit of the Weaving+ series, weaving the immersive blue hours from sunset to moonrise into the case.
Finely woven aramid fiber gives the case a silky, luxurious texture you can feel every time you pick up your phone.

At under 1mm thick, the case shields the Camera Control button with aramid fiber, while a hidden capacitive layer lets you tap and slide effortlessly. The aramid texture stays intact for precise, responsive control.
A sleek, barely-there profile preserves your phone's original feel, ideal for minimalists who want elegant protection without added weight.
